headline: Linn of Mercy Ignites Again as Colonials Secure Fisherman's Row
war_summary: The strategic picture shifts rapidly across the central front as Linn of Mercy erupts into renewed turmoil, recording three base exchanges over the past two hours amidst a fierce contest centered on Lathair, where over thirty-five hundred troops fell in that brief span. Out west, the Colonials have decisively eliminated the final Warden foothold on Fisherman's Row, establishing total control of all nine strategic positions across the island chain following afternoon fighting. While direct base seizures paused along the jagged lines of Weathered Expanse and Stlican Shelf, both sectors remain slaughterhouses of the first order; Weathered Expanse swallowed nearly five thousand casualties in two hours as artillery and infantry clashes accelerate sharply. Heavy attritional fighting without territorial movement also expanded into Nevish Line and Callahan's Passage, with Nevish Line absorbing twenty-four hundred casualties in two hours under mounting enlistments. Across Mooring County, guns have cooled considerably after earlier skirmishes, shifting the war's gravest peril to the simmering contested sectors of the central and eastern corridors.
